audience: nonprofit fundraising and advocacy teams that keep supporter data in Salsa Engage

useCases.title: Find supporters whose details changed
useCases.text: Search supporters by the time their census data changed. Read each record with its address and contacts before you update your own lists.

useCases.title: Review donations and the activity behind them
useCases.text: Search donation transactions by transaction date range. Then search the related activities by supporter or form to see how each gift came in.

useCases.title: Check how an email blast performed
useCases.text: Search recent email blasts by publish date and pick one. Read its per-supporter results: who received, opened or clicked it.

useCases.title: Read a segment and who belongs to it
useCases.text: Get the definition of a segment by its id. Then list its members, or only those who joined since a given time.

useCases.title: Add new supporters with their contact details
useCases.text: List the custom fields first, so the data uses the right names. Then create or update up to 20 supporters per call and check each result.
